name: Mercado Beira-Rio
description: Cross the river to Vila Nova de Gaia for this foodie's dream, an indoor market with various restaurants, food stands, and local products.
longDescription:
The Mercado Beira-Rio is an indoor market located in Vila Nova de Gaia, offering a diverse selection of culinary options. It functions as a permanent gastronomic hub, featuring a collection of independent restaurants, food stalls, and vendors selling regional products. The market aims to showcase the food culture of the Porto region, providing a consistent venue for both residents and visitors to explore local flavors.

Visitors to Mercado Beira-Rio can expect a lively atmosphere within a spacious, covered setting. The market provides an opportunity to sample a range of Portuguese dishes, from traditional snacks to more elaborate meals, alongside various local goods such as cheeses, charcuterie, and baked items. It caters to a broad audience, including families and groups, with options for both quick bites and more leisurely dining.

Entry to Mercado Beira-Rio on April 19, 2026, is free. The market is situated in Vila Nova de Gaia, easily accessible from Porto by crossing the Dom Luís I Bridge. It is within walking distance from the Jardim do Morro metro station (yellow line) and the Gaia cable car terminal.
